title: কেন আমি ডেঙ্গুওয়াচ বিডি বানালাম
note: Founder story, vertical 9:16, talking head. THIS SCRIPT IS A TEMPLATE. Replace every narration with your own true words before generating audio. The press and the public will check the story; an invented or embellished one will sink the launch. Keep it under 60 seconds (about 120 Bangla words). The prompts below are what journalists asked GhushSite's founders.

scenes.prompt: What happened? One concrete moment: who got sick or what you saw, when, where. Name the place, not private details.
What made you angry or stuck? For example: you saw standing water every day and had nowhere to report it.
What you built and in one line how it works: photo, map, ward team clears it, everyone sees.
The ask: report one spot today, or clean one. Say the site name.
